decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed extensions would, by reason of its size, design and position would represent intrusive features detrimental to the visual amenity of the street scene. The proposal is therefore contrary to policies ENV.1.1, H.1.2 and H.3.4 of the Unitary Development Plan and ENV.B.1.1, H.4.1 and H.6.4 of the Unitary Development Plan Revised Deposit 2001.

Condition : 2 - The proposed conversion of the property into self contained units would result in the loss of single family accommodation and would increase noise and disturbance to adjoining residents resulting in detriment to the amenity of the local area contrary to UDP policies ENV.1.1, H.1.5 and H.2.1and Revised Deposit UDP policies ENV-B.1.1, H.3.1 and H.3.4.

Condition : 3 - The proposed car parking provision in the front garden area would prejudice the free flow of traffic and highway safety and detract from the appearance of the visual amenity of the street scene. The proposal is therefore contrary to policy T.2.5 (Parking and Servicing 	Facilities), T3.6 (Road Safety) of the Unitary Development Plan and policies T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities) and T.4.4 (Road Safety) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan.
description: Conversion of dwellinghouse into 2 separate units 1 x ground floor, two bedroom self-contained unit incorporating single storey rear extension and 1 x first floor  three bedroom self contained unit incorporating erection of new roof extension.
